platforms.name: Browser extension (Chromium)
platforms.notes: The packaged zip strips the development key; the Chrome Web Store ID will differ from the unpacked ID. 1.2.1 adds the options footer, store metadata and store-readiness record.

platforms.name: Mac
platforms.state: development · unsigned, needs Developer ID and notarization
platforms.notes: Every target must carry the same MARKETING_VERSION and CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION; 1.1.5 adds the root guardian daemon packaging.

platforms.name: iPhone & iPad
platforms.state: development · no Apple team, Family Controls entitlement or test device
platforms.notes: The app, Safari blockers and HisnActivityMonitor share one version set; 1.1.3 adds the privacy manifest, export compliance, signed list age and policy links.

platforms.name: Android
platforms.state: preview · unsigned; direct builds add the -direct suffix
platforms.notes: versionCode is monotonic and must increase for every uploaded or side-loaded update. 21 adds the bundled-list freshness warning, watchdog status, the list-update decision and notification permission on top of 0.8.0 (API-29 Private DNS and the layer watchdog).
